shared_elements: human figure in profile with beard and headgear
figure's arm extended holding/reaching toward another motif
low-relief figures in a single register on a flat ground
patterned garment with rendered folds or fringe
hair and beard rendered as regular curled rows
justification: Both show a bearded male figure in strict profile with a covered head, an arm extended toward an adjacent motif, and multi-petalled rosette/floral forms, all in shallow relief with hair and beard in regular curled rows — a convention combination that is somewhat specific. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A is a man leading a two-humped pack animal along a register bounded by a rosette band, while B is a large winged, kneeling genie-like figure reaching to a stylised plant, with no animal and no border band.
